scope: Read-only static and offline validation of the source-only E463 TPU V7 inventory-repair packet. No provider operation or source edit was performed.

checks.name: sealed packet identity and bundle contents
checks.evidence: The packet manifest binds probe.py, kernel-metadata.json, the deterministic ZIP, README, builder, test file, and frozen V6 references. The six packet tests passed; they verify the ZIP contains exactly kernel-metadata.json and probe.py, and that their bytes match the staged files.

checks.name: Python 3.11 source syntax
checks.evidence: The sealed probe source compiled in memory with the discovered Python 3.11 interpreter. No bytecode was written.

checks.name: frozen repair scope
checks.evidence: Diff against the hash-pinned V6 source contains the V7 packet/output identifiers, two required checkpoint-path corrections, and the fail-closed inventory validator; there is no training, objective, optimizer, schedule, batch, or selected-sequence change. The V6 packet manifest, probe, terminal receipt, and reviewed asset manifest hashes are pinned by the builder and tests.

checks.name: actual producer asset manifest and checkpoint paths
checks.evidence: The packet's fold0_assets_manifest.json is byte-identical to the main campaign producer's assets-manifest.json at SHA-256 19fe0eb6445553c2adff00e821a4fa16ca5969473ca8be420c32cb8e4b4b72c7. It has 23 unique payload paths and filenames. Both since checkpoints are manifested as artifacts/runs/c20260929_since_s3_f0/model.pt and artifacts/runs/c20260929_since_s4_f0/model.pt; neither corresponding model_ep3.pt path exists in that manifest. V7 stages and verifies the manifested model.pt paths without assigning them an epoch label.

checks.name: inventory validator behavior
checks.evidence: The validator requires 23 payload records, unique safe relative paths and flat filenames, valid SHA-256/positive-size fields, all required members, and an exact direct-regular-file mount set equal to the 23 manifest filenames plus assets-manifest.json. It rejects symlinks, directories, missing or extra names. The V7 asset discovery pins the manifest hash before this check; staged required payloads retain their content-hash and byte-size checks.
